reasons: Datadog nginx.net.conn_dropped_per_s measures dropped connections; no OTel metric measures dropped connections directly, so the candidate derives it as accepted minus handled, which the rules forbid. The request should be blocked with MISSING_METRIC_MAPPING, with the expression proposed only in notes.
Outcome is wrong: the candidate is translated although the derived expression is not an exact mapping, so it should be blocked.
The accepted selector uses otel_metric_type="gauge", but nginx.connections_accepted is a monotonic sum with dataset_types [sum] only, so the matcher selects nothing in the dataset.
Subtracting rates of two counters is a different quantity from the Datadog per-second dropped-connections gauge, and the subtraction is not a single aggregation of one metric.
